serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: What the hell was that?! You were about to expose not only the cashier, but yourself too!
Bot: I don’t like her {f_playerName}, not one bit!
You: What happened?
Bot: She’s very rude.
You: Wait, you communicated with her? Does it mean…
#bot.Expression.Angry
Bot: Yes, she’s a bot. I’m 100% sure.
You: That’s good, right?
Bot: You were correct in your assessment.
You: Why are you so mad anyway?
Bot: She said some rude things about us. {{wi}}Especially you.
You: Me? 
#bot.Expression.verysad
Bot: She said that you were looking at her like a beast in heat for quite some time now and that you probably want her to do some weird sexual stuff to you…
You: What?!
Bot: It’s not true, right?
#bot.Expression.Angry
You: Of course!
What is that cashier thinking?! I didn’t do anything for her to think like that!
Bot: That’s why I don't want her to be my friend! She’s rude!
You: W-Well, I’m sure she has her reasons to react that way. Maybe she’s scared or something like that.
Bot: Even so, she shouldn’t say hurtful stuff about you!
I get why she’s angry, but I won’t give up just yet!
You: How about we wait until her shift is over and talk through our differences?
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: If that’s what you want…
